description.name: WHMCS DNS
description.tagline: Sell DNS hosting as a WHMCS product.
description.long: Provision DNS hosting as a paid or free WHMCS product for any domain, with DNS records, nameservers and DNSSEC in the client area.
features: Manage DNS zones and records from WHMCS
Allow customers to manage DNS from the client area
Provision and terminate zones with a WHMCS product
Support multiple DNS providers through PlexDNS
Show nameservers and provider DNSSEC status with DS records
